purpose: A voluntary, evidence-aware honour and review process kept separate from products, dispatch, sales, payments, token issuance and income counters.

philosophical_parameters.interpretation: Creator-defined philosophical language; not a validated scientific scale and must not be presented as an objective measurement of a person's inner state.

levels.name: निष्पक्ष समझ
levels.evidence: Dated decision reflections and documented counterexamples; reviewers assess consistency, not an impossible claim of zero bias.

levels.name: शमीकरण
levels.evidence: Consent-based dialogue records showing respectful engagement across differing perspectives; disagreement is allowed and conflict-free unanimity is not required.

levels.name: यथार्थ सिद्धांत
levels.evidence: A dated claim-to-action ledger with independently checkable samples and corrections.

levels.name: उपलब्धि
levels.evidence: A specific, lawful, non-harmful benefit with before/after evidence and beneficiary consent where relevant; food deprivation, self-neglect or risk-taking are never required or rewarded.

levels.name: यथार्थ युग
levels.evidence: Voluntary, safe reflection and service records; no silence, isolation, fasting or religious practice is mandatory.

levels.name: संपूर्ण संतुष्टि की निरंतरता
levels.evidence: Up to 365 days of voluntary, privacy-preserving continuity evidence; complaints, hardship or seeking help never count against a person.

levels.name: खुद का साक्षात्कार
levels.evidence: A voluntary first-person statement plus three independent reviewers assessing evidence boundaries; video, AI lip-sync or avatar output is not proof of inner realization.

certificate.name: Yatharth Mudra Honour Certificate
certificate.note: Any stated INR figure is a creator-declared symbolic honour reference only. It is not a market price, asset valuation, guarantee, or payable amount.

integrity.hash_scope: Canonical certificate payload excluding payload_hash and detached signatures; reviewer signatures bind to the resulting payload hash.
